sentences.en: The Lady of the Lake was the ruler of Avalon.
sentences.zh: 湖中女士是阿瓦隆的统治者。

sentences.en: Measure the length of the stick with a ruler.
sentences.zh: 用尺子量一下棍子的长度。

sentences.en: There was once a cruel ruler in the country.
sentences.zh: 这个国家曾经有一个残暴的统治者。

phrases.zh: 他们的直尺/他们的统治者

senses.zh: 尺；统治者；[测] 划线板，划线的人
